title: A review record and a lane lint record carry to a new PR whose tree sha matches a reviewed PR's tree
why: Consultant 00:21 CST Nov 14 (relayed; owner priority fb-1556-6, cut repetition): PR #2980 was re-cut as #3376 only to fix a commit trailer, same tree, and review round 1 and lane lint ran again. OWNER ITEM 835 09:05 CST Nov 14 (pick-review-carry-by-tree, asked by the coordinator 09:03; stale-decision protocol on decision pr-review-record): (a) a new PR whose tree is byte-identical to a reviewed PR may cite that record, read by the tool by tree sha (widens what the tool accepts; marked so); (b) keep each PR reviewed on its own head. No star. Measured (lane merge-tool-beats-every-phase, its own n=1, unread by triage and the coordinator): one test-file fix to #3272's phase beat took 08:00 to about 09:03 CST, 3 PRs (#3272, #3403, #3404), 3 lane-lint runs of 22 min each, 4 review agents; #3404's tree is byte-identical to #3403 head 7bc1717bac09 (empty git diff, the lane's claim); that head holds round 1 FAIL (fixed), round 2 PASS, round 3 PASS, net value zero. Meanwhile the coordinator's own undoable pick: #3404 gets one fresh round 1, and the tool says what else is owed. No check change until the owner answers. This step's lane has built nothing past its read (unread).
source: Consultant message 00:21 CST Nov 14 (relayed). Related, folded or kept apart by the lane: step replacement-pr-carries-review (the fix check names the replaced PR's record), step record-replacement-pr-rounds (a replacement PR keeps the rounds owed), step red-run-pre-push (the cause of the two re-cuts).
note: Triage 00:23 CST Nov 14: when a new PR's tree sha equals the tree sha of a PR that passed review and lane lint, the merge tool and lane lint accept the earlier records for the new PR, so a re-cut does not restart round 1 or the lint cycle. The lane first reads what the two related steps already cover and builds only the gap. A guard change: review rounds apply. Not started. Evidence 00:28 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 00:28, relayed; the lane has it): #3376's carry by tree was refused by the --fix-check chain test (decision pr-review-record) because a new PR has no earlier log; a fresh round 1 runs.
